LESSON: LANGUAGE USE 9.3.1 COMMON AND PROPER NOUNS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade one
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.3: Language use 9.3.1 Common and proper nouns
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Language use 9.3.1 Common and proper nouns, part of Strand 9 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade one General.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to refer to people and places by their names? 2. What things can you see in the classroom?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Language use 9.3.1 Common and proper nouns together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication – learner’s speaking skills are enhanced as the learner contributes to group discussion and recognizes the value of other’s

ideas.

Values:
Respect is achieved as the learners understand and appreciate each other when talking about what their friends like using common and proper

nouns.

English

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Citizenship is nurtured as learners acquire a sense of togetherness when talking about their friends.

Links to other Learning Areas:
